data.subject: Local Ledger four-week pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Gem Investment Advisors' most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in TRC, PCYO, and STHO.

TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier, up 71.7% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records, including permits, agendas, call reports, and filings; every claim is cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
